architecture: packed Choice head, frozen encoder, learned 128-d projection for shortlist only
training_data: Banking77 train.csv first 600-800 rows after seed 17 shuffle, shortlist projection only
calibration_data: AG News public test rows 0:400 seed 17 for choice:3-5; Banking77 public test rows 0:80 for choice:11+ at 20 options
test_data: AG News public test rows 400:800; Banking77 public test rows 80:160 for choice:11+; Banking77 rows 400:440 for honest shortlist
hardware: macOS arm64, MPS for the forward passes, CPU for the reloaded check
conclusion: choice:3-5 and choice:11+ temperatures from the fitter improved held-out NLL and ECE with accuracy unchanged, and are loaded from calibration.json. The learned shortlist raises Banking77 recall far above frozen cosine but top-8 reranking did not beat packed 20-way Choice. The candidate-set and ordinal heads were not trained.
